description: 서울시설공단_버스 공영 차고지 현황_GW [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울시설공단. 또한 세부적으로는 차고지 번호, 전화번호, 입주업체 수, 주차장 시설규모, 건물 시설규모, CNG(압축천연가스) 시설규모, 녹지 시설규모 등의 항목이 함께 제공되어, 각 차고지의 시설. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울시설공단. Its tags are 공영 차고지 현황, 공영 차고지 위치, 권역별 버스공영차고지, 운영 현황, 시설규모. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
